name: Hyperion
research_notes: Dedicated bouldering hall (600+ m2 claimed, roughly 80 problems). Homepage advertises an Autumn Boulder Week 2026 event and says the club runs year-round. Same venue also has a paintball operation (OSM tags both). A separate outdoor X-Park at Muromets park is not a candidate. Site hours for the wall: Mon-Fri 11:00-21:45, Sat-Sun 10:00-19:00.

name: UP!
research_notes: Self-described bouldering hall. Prices and weekday/weekend hours are published; the newest dated post on its feed is from August 2025 (a closure notice for 16-17 August, which implies normal operation). The site embeds a Google map centred near 50.40061, 30.51303, within about 100 m of the OSM pin. No 2026 post seen, so freshness of the status is moderate.

name: Funattic
address: вул. Борщагівська, 154, ТРЦ Мармелад, 6 поверх, Київ
research_notes: Marmalade shopping centre, 6th floor. Bouldering zone plus a 9 m rope wall with auto-belay. Hours on the contacts page: Mon-Fri 11:00-21:45, Sat-Sun 11:00-18:00. No dated post on the site; its theme files were regenerated in June 2026 and the shop is live, the only dated sign of activity. Some directories list it under the older name Tsekh. The Google link on the site gives a pin near 50.44641, 30.44282, about 60 m from the OSM point.

name: KPI Climbing Club
address: вул. Верхньоключева, 1/26, Спорткомплекс КПІ (ліве крило, 4 поверх), Київ
research_notes: Club on the KPI university campus with adult (enrolment open on the homepage), student and children sections. The former domain kpiskala.com.ua redirects here. Homepage names bouldering and top rope. OSM node carries climbing:boulder=yes. Site assets are dated up to September 2026. Access is through club sections and a first training, so treated as a club; drop-in access not confirmed.

name: The Wall Kyiv
address: просп. Степана Бандери, 36, ТРЦ Blockbuster Mall, 2 поверх, Київ
research_notes: Part of SPACE Group (with Boulder Space, Climbing SPACE and The Wall Lviv). Homepage describes natural-granite style holds, 18 auto-belay lines up to 12 m and an instructor on site daily; it does not mention a bouldering area, so bouldering is left unknown rather than assumed. Open daily 10:00-21:45 per the site, which links 2026 Instagram posts. Different venue from The Wall Lviv.

name: The Wall Lviv
address: вул. Героїв УПА, 72, БЦ Технопарк, Львів
research_notes: Separate modern bouldering zone plus 7-12 m rope walls and an interactive 12Climb wall. Homepage promotes The Wall Cup BoulderFest 2026. Joined SPACE Group in 2022. The site publishes business coordinates near 49.83138, 23.99679 (about 90 m from the OSM point). OSM lists the old website the-wall.com.ua, which now returns 403; ignore it.

name: Bukhta
research_notes: Official site describes a bouldering stand of about 350 m2 and a 14 m high wall. The newest content on the site is from 2019, so there is no dated sign of operation in 2025-2026. Directories give the address Siayvo 12. Verify by phone or social page before accepting.

name: MurawayNick
research_notes: About 270 m2, bouldering is the main focus, with a high wall and a speed wall. Opened 2014 at Pushkinska 13, moved to Freedom Square 5 in 2017. The site shows hours but its news feed stops in 2020, so no dated 2025-2026 sign; Kharkiv is a frontline city, status left unknown. OSM also holds an older entry Muravey at Skovorody 13 (node/3084515470, website domain now unrelated); not used. Different gym from FormAT.

name: FormAT
address: просп. Аерокосмічний (раніше Гагаріна), 20а, ТЦ На Гагаріна, Харків
research_notes: Climbing club with a bouldering school, near Levada metro. Homepage news dated 3 February 2026 reports a Junior Boulder Fest 2026, a dated sign of operation. The site also says the club is looking for a place for a new wall. The contact page links a Google place pin near 49.98134, 36.24534, close to the OSM point. Public drop-in access is not confirmed (adult and children training offered).

name: Montana

coord_source.ref: https://montana.dp.ua/contacts/ (Google Maps embed centred on the address)

research_notes: Self-described bouldering hall with soft mats throughout. Hours Mon-Fri 10:00-22:00, Sat-Sun 09:00-21:00. Blog reports Montana Boulder Fest 2025 for the 12th anniversary, a dated sign of operation. Coordinates come from a zoomed-out embed centred on the address, so street-level accuracy only; no OSM element exists for it. Also listed in the January 2025 Dnipro overview.

name: La Scala
research_notes: Complex in central Dnipro that a directory describes as a large bouldering hall plus three outdoor trainers; opened 2013. No working official site found: the website in OSM (rockcenter.dp.ua) now serves an unrelated betting page and must not be used. Social pages (Instagram skalodromlascala, Facebook dneprscala) are not readable here, so bouldering and status stay unknown. Not the Skala gym at Karavan mall.

name: Skala
research_notes: Indoor wall of over 300 m2 in the Karavan mall with trainer-led subscriptions and a claimed tallest indoor wall in the region. The official page never says bouldering; the January 2025 Dnipro overview says bouldering is available (under the name Skelia). No dated post on the official page, so status unknown. Distinct from La Scala.

name: Energy Wall
research_notes: Site offers a first climb, individual training and group sections on routes up to 8 m with belaying. No bouldering mention found. Hours Tue-Fri 15:00-21:00, Sat 12:30-19:00, Sun 10:00-17:00, but no dated post, so status unknown (Zaporizhzhia is near the front).

name: Climbing Room (Girska Maisternia)
research_notes: Non-commercial training room of a mountaineering club; anyone aged 16+ can join bouldering sessions (Tue/Thu 17:00-20:00, Sun 12:00-15:00) for a donation. The page carries no date, so status is unknown. An unnamed OSM climbing node (node/347280952) lies about 20 m away. The same club also runs a Kremenets room that is not a candidate.

name: SK Dynamica

coord_source.ref: https://dynamica.od.ua/ua/kontakty/ (Google Maps embed for the address)

research_notes: Multi-sport complex with a new bouldering and climbing hall (walls to 4.3 m, mats, 12Climb interactive wall, bookable 08:00-22:00 daily). No dated post found, only a site footer year, so status unknown. Embed is zoomed out, so street-level accuracy only. No OSM element found for it.

name: Ostriv
research_notes: Climbing centre in Kyiv known from OSM and a Facebook page whose public description lists climbing and bouldering among its topics; no schedule, address or dated post readable, so bouldering and status are unknown. Needs a street address and a fresh sign of operation.
